blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: Edgar Degas was luckier than many painters.
exercises.why: **удачливый → удачливее** — comparative: stem + -ее (-ей).

exercises.prompt: I can't swim any further.
exercises.why: **большой → больше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: I'm no more diligent than he is.
exercises.why: **старательный → старательнее** — comparative: stem + -ее (-ей).

exercises.prompt: It would cost twice as much as that.
exercises.why: **дорогой → дороже** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: Be more careful from now on.
exercises.why: **осторожный → осторожней** — comparative: stem + -ее (-ей).

exercises.q: Когда прошёл дождь и почва сырая, становится ___ (простой) полоть сорняки.
exercises.prompt: When rain's fallen and the soil is moist, it becomes easier to pull out weeds.
exercises.why: **простой → проще** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: The withdrawal symptoms are more severe than I thought.
exercises.why: **тяжёлый → тяжелее** — comparative: stem + -ее (-ей).

exercises.q: Том, возможно, всего на год-два ___ (молодой) Мэри.
exercises.prompt: Tom is probably just a year or two younger than Mary.
exercises.why: **два моложе** — 2–4, 22–24, 32–34… (not 12–14) take the genitive singular (молодой → моложе).

exercises.q: Если человеческая природа эволюционирует, то ненамного ___ (быстрый), чем геологический профиль Земли.
exercises.prompt: If human nature is evolving, it's not much faster than the geological profile of the Earth.
exercises.why: **быстрый → быстрее** — comparative: stem + -ее (-ей).

exercises.prompt: My cousin is a little older than I.
exercises.why: **старший → старше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.q: Профилактические меры намного ___ (эффективный), чем лечение по факту.
exercises.prompt: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.
exercises.why: **эффективный → эффективнее** — comparative: stem + -ее (-ей).

exercises.prompt: This hat is less expensive than that one.
exercises.why: **дешёвый → дешевле** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.q: Нет ничего ___ (интересный), чем диалог двух безмолвных влюбленных.
exercises.prompt: Nothing holds more interest than the dialog between two silent lovers.
exercises.why: **интересный → интереснее** — comparative: stem + -ее (-ей).

exercises.prompt: Nothing is as hard as a diamond.
exercises.why: **твёрдый → твёрже** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.q: Эта история с яблоком, падающим на голову Ньютона, - ___ (вероятный) всего, апокриф.
exercises.prompt: That story about an apple falling on Newton's head is most probably apocryphal.
exercises.why: **вероятный → вероятнее** — comparative: stem + -ее (-ей).

exercises.q: У господина Янга не ___ (маленький) шести машин.
exercises.prompt: Mr Young has no less than six cars.
exercises.why: **маленький → меньше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: A bear is bigger than a wolf.
exercises.why: **крупный → крупнее** — comparative: stem + -ее (-ей).

exercises.prompt: Takada is the richest out of all of us.
exercises.why: **богатый → богаче** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.

exercises.prompt: They became more and more nervous.
exercises.why: **нервозный → нервознее** — comparative: stem + -ее (-ей).

exercises.q: Я стараюсь держаться ___ (далёкий) от политики и её неадекватностей.
exercises.prompt: I am trying to distance myself from politics and its inadequacies.
exercises.why: **далёкий → подальше** — irregular comparative: the stem changes.
